title: Expose canon-tier evidence in debug audit logs
description:
Improve debug/audit visibility for canon-tier evidence.

When a turn is accepted or rejected, the debug artifacts should make it clear which claims were supported by which evidence tier.

Acceptance criteria:
- Debug output for audited turns shows relevant evidence sources by tier:
  - module canon
  - campaign state
  - campaign overlay lore
  - scene context
  - tool result
- Rejections identify whether missing support was:
  - no successful query
  - only failed query
  - unsupported module contradiction
  - rumor used as confirmed fact
  - consequential improvisation not recorded
- Accepted turns involving record_world_fact/record_lore show the newly recorded overlay fact IDs.
- The output is concise enough to be useful in playtest logs.
close_reason: Implemented campaign overlay canon, truth-statused lore recording, world_query retrieval/search, audit/prompt guidance, docs, and regression coverage.
